stories.title: 'Gamechanging' brain tumour test reduces diagnosis from eight weeks to two hours
stories.label: health
stories.summary: Doctors in England now have a rapid new test that can identify a brain tumour type while a patient is still on the operating table. What used to take up to eight weeks of waiting for lab results can now be known in about two hours. That means surgeons can make better decisions about treatment right away, instead of leaving patients and families in limbo for weeks. NHS England is already piloting it in five hospitals around the country.
stories.why_good: A real, working medical breakthrough that is already being used on actual patients, cutting an agonizing wait down to hours.

stories.title: Seahorse habitats 'healing' thanks to eco-moorings
stories.label: ocean
stories.summary: Off the coast of England, a beautiful seagrass meadow at Studland Bay had been getting scarred by boats dropping heavy anchor chains. Conservationists swapped those chains for special eco-friendly moorings that don't drag on the seafloor, and a new study confirms it's working. The torn-up patches are now visibly healing and regrowing. That matters because these meadows are a vital nursery for seahorses and other marine life. It's a lovely example of a small, practical fix actually paying off in nature.
stories.why_good: A completed intervention with verified, measurable ecological recovery; no politics, no disaster framing.

stories.title: Nike Founder Phil Knight Gives Away a Billion Dollars – the Largest Single Donation to a Public University
stories.label: people
stories.summary: Phil Knight, the man who co-founded Nike with his old track coach, just gave his alma mater the University of Oregon a jaw-dropping billion-dollar gift. It's the largest single donation ever made to a public university in the country. The money will help fund the school for generations of students to come. Knight has spent decades giving back to the university that shaped his life, and this caps it off in historic fashion. It's a beautiful full-circle story of loyalty and generosity.
stories.why_good: A real, completed act of massive generosity that will concretely help a public university and its students for years, with no political angle.
